newsitem.title: USA: VISHAY says Q1, 1997 estimates in range.
newsitem.headline: VISHAY says Q1, 1997 estimates in range.

text.p: Vishay Intertechnology Inc Chief Financial Officer Richard Grubb said analyst's estimates the firm would earn $0.34 a share in the first quarter and $1.59 in 1997 were "within range."
"They're within in range of what we have felt we were comfortable with," Grubb told Reuters after an appearance by company chairman Felix Zandman at an Emerald Asset Management Seminar.

Zandman told the seminar the company's key tantalum capacitor market had begun to rebound after a disappointing 1996, when earnings slumped to $1.29 -- before a $0.43 cent -- charge from $1.69 the year before.
"I believe presently that we have turned a corner," Zandman said.
